newsitem.title: USA: Dial Corp to stay in Arizona.
newsitem.headline: Dial Corp to stay in Arizona.

text.p: Dial Corp said Friday it has decided to move its corporate headquarters to Scottsdale, a suburb near its present headquarters in Phoenix.

The company said in September it planned to vacate its headquarters as part of an extensive cost-cutting program. The decision quells local concerns that the consumer packaging giant may be moving out of state.
Dial's brands include Dial soaps, Purex detergents, Renuzit air fresheners and Armour Star canned meats.
